newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury fire extinguished, none hurt.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury fire extinguished, none hurt.

text.p: A fire in a basement of the British Treasury building was extinguished on Tuesday and no-one was injured in the blaze, fire brigade officials said.
"I can confirm the fire is out although we have still got heavy smoke in the basement," a brigade spokesman told Reuters.
Eyewitnesses said staff who had been evacuated as a precaution were returning to their desks.
The spokesman said the extent of damage was not known.
